title: rhus aromatica var. trilobata
intro: Rhus aromatica var. trilobata, commonly known as Trilobed Sumac, is a shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Trilobed Sumac include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe and calm irritated skin and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
